title: Guzman y Gomez Gives Up on Failing US Business; Shares Soar
title_zh: 古兹曼和戈麦斯放弃了失败的美国企业；股价飙升
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Australian burrito chain Guzman y Gomez Ltd. is closing its Chicago restaurants immediately and exiting the US in an abrupt end to an attempt to crack the world’s biggest fast-food market.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——澳大利亚墨西哥卷饼连锁店 Guzman y Gomez Ltd. 将立即关闭其在芝加哥的餐厅，并退出美国市场，从而结束其进军全球最大快餐市场的尝试。

title: Texas sues Meta, WhatsApp over encryption privacy claims
title_zh: 德克萨斯州起诉 Meta 和 WhatsApp 加密隐私索赔
summary: The Texas Attorney General’s Office on Thursday sued WhatsApp and its parent company Meta ‌Platforms Inc alleging they misled consumers about the strength and ‌scope of WhatsApp's encryption measures, which a Meta spokesman denied.
summary_zh: 德克萨斯州总检察长办公室周四起诉 WhatsApp 及其母公司 Meta Platforms Inc，指控他们在 WhatsApp 加密措施的强度和范围方面误导消费者，Meta 发言人对此予以否认。

title: Apple asks US Supreme Court to review contempt order in Epic Games lawsuit
title_zh: 苹果要求美国最高法院审查 Epic Games 诉讼中的藐视法庭令
summary: Apple asked the U.S. Supreme Court on Thursday to review a lower court ruling that held the iPhone maker in ‌civil contempt over fees it was charging on some outside purchases made by customers ‌of its App Store.
summary_zh: 苹果公司周四要求美国最高法院审查下级法院的一项裁决，该裁决认为这家 iPhone 制造商对其 App Store 客户进行的一些外部购买收取费用，构成民事藐视法庭罪。
